resources.string: The game files are not installed yet.\n\nChoose your Battlefield 2: Modern Combat (USA) Xbox 360 disc image (.iso) on this device. It is copied into the app once (about 4 GB); you can delete the .iso afterwards.
Installing the game files. Keep the app open.
This is not the disc this port supports: its default.xex does not match (SHA-256 %1$s). Other regions and releases will not run. Choose another image.
That file is not an Xbox disc image (no XDVDFS volume found). Choose your Battlefield 2: Modern Combat .iso.
Not enough free space: %1$.1f GB needed, %2$.1f GB free. Free some space and try again.
No file picker is available on this device.
The game is drawn at 16:9. On a wider screen this stretches the picture to the edges instead of leaving black bars. Applies the next time the game starts.
In the campaign, player 2 takes over a teammate with the second controller. Each player gets half the frame rate.
